file_name: Challenger - Channel Capital and Fidante - Third-party questionnaire - Phase 1 consultation - 14 September 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Fidante or any business controlled or managed by Challenger are close competitors to Channel Capital and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Challenger, Fidante and/or Channel Capital.
